messages:
elaine: Quick sync — finalizing logistics for next Tuesday's virtual event. Need owners for: reg page copy + toggles, Zoom recording config, and post-event clip/email flow.

sam: I can take the reg page edits. Landing needs a GDPR consent toggle and an opt-in checkbox for product updates. Simple copy ok?

katie: Yep on copy. Can you add UTM params so marketing can tie the benchmark promo? utm_campaign=rdw-infer_launch&utm_source=email_social

sam: Will add. Also adding a hidden field for "region" so we can route local sales.

devon: Zoom config: enable cloud recording, both gallery+active speaker, and auto-transcribe. Need SRT for captions. Also enable alternative hosts for recording.

elaine: @devon confirmed — ops doc requires: record to cloud, automatically generate transcript, and SRT export. Can we also enable local fallback RTMP in case cloud fails? 

devon: Yes — RTMP fallback set in meeting advanced settings. I will schedule a test on Friday.

katie: Who's owning post-event clip split + highlight email? We want 3 short clips: product demo (0-4m), benchmarks (4-8m), Q&A (8m+).

sam: I can own clips. Can ops-bot create the GDrive folder and share with marketing + product?

ops-bot: Created folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cExample — permissions: marketing@example.com, product@example.com :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks. I'll drop a note with timestamps after the event.

elaine: HubSpot mapping: we need form -> list logic: if region=EMEA then owner=emea-sales, else owner=na-sales. Also tag leads with "webinar:product-launch" and "traffic:benchmark".

katie: Sample Zap mapping (add to runbook):
```
hubspot_form_id: 9f7a2b3c
fields:
  - email -> contact.email
  - name -> contact.firstname
  - company -> contact.company
  - region -> contact.region
  - utm_campaign -> contact.utm_campaign
routing:
  rule1: region==EMEA -> owner=emea-sales
  rule2: region!=EMEA -> owner=na-sales
```

devon: For caption accuracy, set transcript language to en-US and attach captions (.srt) to the Drive folder automatically. Zoom API will export srt to cloud; I'll wire a Lambda to copy to Drive if needed.

elaine: Post-event emails: 1) same-day replay + 3 clips 2) 48h follow-up with CTA to trial 3) 2-week bench report invite. Who drafts the same-day replay?

katie: I'll draft same-day and 48h. Can product write the bench report invite copy?

sam: One more — consent logging. We need a CSV export of consent flags with timestamp for legal. Add to runbook.

elaine: Good call. Add export step after event: Zapier -> S3 -> legal bucket.

ops-bot: Reminder: test meeting + recording rehearsal scheduled Fri 11:00 PT. All hosts invited. :bell:

elaine: Perfect. Action items: sam=reg page + clips; devon=zoom settings + srt pipeline; katie=emails + utm; ops-bot=drive + test. We'll reconvene after the dress rehearsal. :white_check_mark:
